                    #'make-reset-name
                    #'make-reset-form
                    #'make-cache-querier)))))))

(defmacro with-cache ((cache-type &rest cache-attribs) def-form)
  "CACHE-TYPE := :HASH-TABLE | :ARRAY.
DEF-FORM := definition form with DEFUN, LABELS, FLET, or SB-INT:NAMED-LET."
  (multiple-value-bind (cache-symbol cache-form cache-type name-alias
                        make-reset-name make-reset-form
                        make-cache-querier)
      (%parse-cache-form (cons cache-type cache-attribs))
    (ecase (car def-form)
      ((defun)
       (destructuring-bind (_ name args &body body) def-form
         (declare (ignore _))
         `(let ((,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
            (defun ,(funcall make-reset-name name) ()
              ,(funcall make-reset-form cache-type))
            (defun ,name ,args
              ,@(%extract-declarations body)
              (labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type name args))))))
      ((labels flet)
       (destructuring-bind (_ definitions &body labels-body) def-form
         (declare (ignore _))
         (destructuring-bind (name args &body body) (car definitions)
           `(let ((,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
              (,(car def-form)
               ((,(funcall make-reset-name name) ()
                 ,(funcall make-reset-form cache-type))
                (,name ,args
                       ,@(%extract-declarations body)
                       (labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                         (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                         ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type name args)))
                ,@(cdr definitions))
               (declare (ignorable #',(funcall make-reset-name name)))
               ,@labels-body)))))
      ((nlet #+sbcl sb-int:named-let)
       (destructuring-bind (_ name bindings &body body) def-form
         (declare (ignore _))
         `(let ((,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
            (,(car def-form) ,name ,bindings
             ,@(%extract-declarations body)
             ,(let ((args (mapcar (lambda (x) (if (atom x) x (car x))) bindings)))
                `(labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                   (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                   ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type name args))))))))))

(defmacro with-caches (cache-specs def-form)
  "DEF-FORM := definition form by LABELS or FLET.

 (with-caches (cache-spec1 cache-spec2)
   (labels ((f (x) ...) (g (y) ...))))
is equivalent to the line up of
 (with-cache cache-spec1 (labels ((f (x) ...))))
and
 (with-cache cache-spec2 (labels ((g (y) ...))))

This macro will be useful to do mutual recursion between memoized local
functions."
  (assert (member (car def-form) '(labels flet)))
  (let (cache-symbol-list cache-form-list cache-type-list name-alias-list make-reset-name-list make-reset-form-list make-cache-querier-list)
    (dolist (cache-spec (reverse cache-specs))
      (multiple-value-bind (cache-symbol cache-form cache-type name-alias
                            make-reset-name make-reset-form make-cache-querier)
          (%parse-cache-form cache-spec)
        (push cache-symbol cache-symbol-list)
        (push cache-form cache-form-list)
        (push cache-type cache-type-list)
        (push name-alias name-alias-list)
        (push make-reset-name make-reset-name-list)
        (push make-reset-form make-reset-form-list)
        (push make-cache-querier make-cache-querier-list)))
    (labels ((def-name (def) (first def))
             (def-args (def) (second def))
             (def-body (def) (cddr def)))
      (destructuring-bind (_ definitions &body labels-body) def-form
        (declare (ignore _))
        `(let ,(loop for cache-symbol in cache-symbol-list
                     for cache-form in cache-form-list
                     collect `(,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
           (,(car def-form)
            (,@(loop for def in definitions
                     for cache-type in cache-type-list
                     for make-reset-name in make-reset-name-list
                     for make-reset-form in make-reset-form-list
                     collect `(,(funcall make-reset-name (def-name def)) ()
                               ,(funcall make-reset-form cache-type)))
             ,@(loop for def in definitions
                     for cache-type in cache-type-list
                     for name-alias in name-alias-list
                     for make-cache-querier in make-cache-querier-list
                     collect `(,(def-name def) ,(def-args def)
                               ,@(%extract-declarations (def-body def))
                               (labels ((,name-alias ,(def-args def) ,@(def-body def)))
                                 (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                                 ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type (def-name def) (def-args def))))))
            (declare (ignorable ,@(loop for def in definitions
                                        for make-reset-name in make-reset-name-list
                                        collect `#',(funcall make-reset-name
                                                             (def-name def)))))
            ,@labels-body))))))

(defvar ht (make-hash-table :test 'equal))

(defun solve-upper (x A B C D)
  (cond 
    ((= x 0) 0)
    (#1=(gethash x ht) #1#)
    (t (setf #1# (min (* x D)
                      (+ C (* D (mod x 5))
                         (solve-upper (floor x 5) A B C D))
                      (+ B (* D (mod x 3))
                         (solve-upper (floor x 3) A B C D))
                      (+ A (* D (mod x 2))
                         (solve-upper (floor x 2) A B C D)))))))  

(defun solve-lower (x A B C D)
  (cond 
    ((= x 0) 0)
    (#1=(gethash x ht) #1#)
    (t (setf #1# (min (* x D)
                      (+ C (* D (mod (- x) 5))
                         (solve-upper (ceiling x 5) A B C D))
                      (+ B (* D (mod (- x) 3))
                         (solve-upper (ceiling x 3) A B C D))
                      (+ A (* D (mod (- x) 2))
                         (solve-upper (ceiling x 2) A B C D)))))))

(defun solve (N A B C D)
  (let (upper lower)
       (clrhash ht)
       (setf upper (solve-upper N A B C D))
       (clrhash ht)
       (setf lower (solve-lower N A B C D))
       (princ (min lower upper))
       (terpri)))

;; arguments. In this case ADD stores the key (CONS A B) and the returned value

;; array:
;; (with-cache (:array (10 20 30) :initial-element -1 :element-type 'fixnum)
;;   (defun foo (a b c) ... ))
;; This form stores the value of FOO in an array created by (make-array (list 10
;; 20 30) :initial-element -1 :element-type 'fixnum). Note that INITIAL-ELEMENT
;; must always be given here as it is used as the flag expressing `not yet
;; stored'. (Therefore INITIAL-ELEMENT should be a value FOO never takes.)

def honyarara(n,cost)
  q = []
  arr = [2,3,5]
  q.push([1,8])
  min = Float::INFINITY
  while q != []
    f = q.first
    if f[0] == n
      min = [min, f[1]].min
      q.shift
      next
    end
    arr.each do |val|
      q.push([f[0]*val, f[1]+cost[val]]) if f[0] <= n
    end
    if f[0] < n
      q.push([f[0]+1, f[1]+cost[1]]) if n - f[0] <= 1
    else
      q.push([f[0]-1, f[1]+cost[1]]) if f[0] - n <= 1
    end
    q.shift
  end
  puts min
end

class Problem
  MOD = 10007
  MAX = 10 ** 12
  attr_reader :a, :b, :c, :d, :memo, :cost

  def initialize(a, b, c, d)
    @a = a; @b = b; @c = c; @d = d
    @memo = { 0 => 0, 1 => @d }
    @cost = { 2 => @a, 3 => @b, 5 => @c}
  end

  def solve(n)
    return memo[n] if memo[n]
    mini = MAX
    candidates(n) do |to, cost|
      now = solve(to) + cost
      mini = now if now < mini
    end
    memo[n] = mini
  end

  def candidates(n)
    yield [0, d * n]
    [2, 3, 5].each do |i|
      j = cost[i]
      if i <= n
        yield [n / i, j + d * (n % i)]
      end

      if n % i != 0
        yield [(n + i - 1) / i, j + d * (i - n % i)]
      end
    end
  end
end

class Resolver

  def self.init(a, b, c, d)
    log { "A = #{a}, B = #{b}, C = #{c}, D = #{d}" }
    @@resolved = { 0 => 0, 1 => d }
    log { "n = 1, pay: D = #{d}" }
    if a + d < d * 2
      @@resolved[2] = a + d
      log { "n = 2, pay: A + D = #{a + d}" }
    else
      @@resolved[2] = d * 2
      log { "n = 2, pay: 2D = #{d * 2}" }
    end
    @@label_map = {
      "A" => a,
      "B" => b,
      "C" => c,
      "D" => d,
    }
  end

  def self.resolved
    @@resolved
  end

  def self.label_map
    @@label_map
  end

  class Calc

    MUL = {
      "A" => 2,
      "B" => 3,
      "C" => 5,
    }

    attr_reader :next_n

    def initialize(next_n, cur_pay, abc, d_cnt)
      @next_n = next_n
      @cur_pay = cur_pay
      total_pay
      if DEBUG
        d = Resolver.label_map["D"]
        if abc
          @label = "#{abc}#{MUL[abc]}(#{Resolver.label_map[abc]})"
          if d_cnt > 0
            @label += " + #{d_cnt}D(#{d_cnt}*#{d})"
          end
        elsif d_cnt
          @label = "#{d_cnt}D(#{d_cnt}*#{d})"
        end
        # log { "Register: #{to_s}" }
      end
    end

    def total_pay
      if @total_pay.nil? && @next_pay = Resolver.resolved[@next_n]
        @total_pay = @next_pay + @cur_pay
      end
      @total_pay
    end

    def to_s
      "# next_n = #{@next_n}, total pay = #{@total_pay}, cur pay: #{@label} = #{@cur_pay}"
    end
  end

  attr_reader :n, :resolved

  def initialize(n)
    @n = n
    @resolved = nil
    @stack = []
  end

  def register(next_n, cur_pay, abc, d_cnt)
    return if abc && next_n == 0
    @stack.push(Calc.new(next_n, cur_pay, abc, d_cnt))
  end

  def resolve
    if calc = @stack.find {|c| c.total_pay.nil? }
      calc.next_n
    else
      calc = @stack.min {|a, b| a.total_pay <=> b.total_pay }
      @resolved = @@resolved[@n] = calc.total_pay
      if DEBUG
        log { "[n = #{@n}, pay = #{@resolved}]" }
        @stack.each do |c|
          $stderr.puts c
        end
      end
      nil
    end
  end
  
end

class Entry
  attr_reader :n, :a, :b, :c, :d, :cache

  def initialize(line)

  def pay
    Resolver.init(@a, @b, @c, @d)

    r = Resolver.new(@n)
    loop do

      p2c = @a + nm2 * @d
      r.register(nn2, p2c, "A", nm2)

      nn3, nm3 = n.divmod(3)

      p3c2 = @b + (3 - nm3) * @d
      r.register(nn3, p3c1, "B", nm3)

      nn5, nm5 = n.divmod(5)
      p5c1 = @c + nm5 * @d

      r.register(nn5, p5c1, "C", nm5)

      p1 = n * @d
      r.register(0, p1, nil, n)
      if next_n = r.resolve
        resolvers.push(r)

      else
        loop do
          if resolvers.empty?
            return r.resolved
          end
          if next_n = resolvers[-1].resolve
            break
          end
          r = resolvers.pop
        end
        r = Resolver.new(next_n)

    end
  end

def fn(p,v,n,a,b,c,d)
  if v % 5 == 0
    p += c
    v = v / 5
    return [p,v]
  end
  if v % 3 == 0
    p += b
    v = v / 3
    return [p,v]
  end
  if v % 2 == 0
    p += a
    v = v / 2
    return [p,v]
  end
  p += d
  v += -1
  return [p,v]
end

class Resolver

  def self.init(a, b, c, d)
    log { "A = #{a}, B = #{b}, C = #{c}, D = #{d}" }
    @@resolved = { 0 => 0, 1 => d }
    @@label_map = {
      "A" => a,
      "B" => b,
      "C" => c,
      "D" => d,
    }
  end

  def self.resolved
    @@resolved
  end

  def self.label_map
    @@label_map
  end

  class Calc

    MUL = {
      "A" => 2,
      "B" => 3,
      "C" => 5,
    }

    attr_reader :next_n

    def initialize(next_n, cur_pay, abc, d_cnt)
      @next_n = next_n
      @cur_pay = cur_pay
      total_pay
      if DEBUG
        d = Resolver.label_map["D"]
        if abc
          @label = "#{abc}#{MUL[abc]}(#{Resolver.label_map[abc]})"
          if d_cnt > 0
            @label += " + #{d_cnt}D(#{d_cnt}*#{d})"
          end
        elsif d_cnt
          @label = "#{d_cnt}D(#{d_cnt}*#{d})"
        end
      end
    end

    def total_pay
      if @total_pay.nil? && @next_pay = Resolver.resolved[@next_n]
        @total_pay = @next_pay + @cur_pay
      end
      @total_pay
    end

    def to_s
      "# next_n = #{@next_n}, total pay = #{@total_pay}, cur pay: #{@label} = #{@cur_pay}"
    end
  end

  attr_reader :n, :resolved

  def initialize(n)
    @n = n
    @resolved = nil
    @stack = []
  end

  def register(next_n, cur_pay, abc, d_cnt)
    @stack.push(Calc.new(next_n, cur_pay, abc, d_cnt))
  end

  def resolve
    if calc = @stack.find {|c| c.total_pay.nil? }
      calc.next_n
    else
      calc = @stack.min {|a, b| a.total_pay <=> b.total_pay }
      @resolved = @@resolved[@n] = calc.total_pay
      if DEBUG
        log { "[n = #{@n}, pay = #{@resolved}]" }
        @stack.each do |c|
          $stderr.puts c
        end
      end
      nil
    end
  end
  
end

class Entry
  attr_reader :n, :a, :b, :c, :d, :cache

  def initialize(line)
    @n, @a, @b, @c, @d = line.split.map {|i| i.to_i }
  end

  def pay
    Resolver.init(@a, @b, @c, @d)
    resolvers = []
    r = Resolver.new(@n)
    loop do
      n = r.n
      nn2, nm2 = n.divmod(2)
      p2c = @a + nm2 * @d
      r.register(nn2, p2c, "A", nm2)
      nn3, nm3 = n.divmod(3)
      p3c1 = @b + nm3 * @d
      p3c2 = @b + (3 - nm3) * @d
      r.register(nn3, p3c1, "B", nm3)
      r.register(nn3 + 1, p3c2, "B", 3 - nm3)
      nn5, nm5 = n.divmod(5)
      p5c1 = @c + nm5 * @d
      p5c2 = @c + (5 - nm5) * @d
      r.register(nn5, p5c1, "C", nm5)
      r.register(nn5 + 1, p5c2, "C", 5 - nm5)
      p1 = n * @d
      r.register(0, p1, nil, n)
      if next_n = r.resolve
        resolvers.push(r)
        r = Resolver.new(next_n)
      else
        loop do
          if resolvers.empty?
            return r.resolved
          end
          if next_n = resolvers[-1].resolve
            break
          end
          r = resolvers.pop
        end
        r = Resolver.new(next_n)
      end
    end
  end
end

def rec(n, memo, a, b, c, d)
  return 0 if n==0
  return d if n==1
  return memo[n] if memo[n]
  
  min = n*d
  if n%2==0
    tmp = rec(n/2, memo, a, b, c, d)+a
    min = tmp if min > tmp
  else
    m = n%2
    l = 2-m
    tmp1 = rec((n-m)/2, memo, a, b, c, d)+a+(d*m)
    tmp2 = rec((n+l)/2, memo, a, b, c, d)+a+(d*l)
    min = tmp1 if min > tmp1
    min = tmp2 if min > tmp2
  end
  
  if n%3==0
    tmp = rec(n/3, memo, a, b, c, d)+b
    min = tmp if min > tmp
  else
    m = n%3
    l = 3-m
    tmp1 = rec((n-m)/3, memo, a, b, c, d)+b+(d*m)
    tmp2 = rec((n+l)/3, memo, a, b, c, d)+b+(d*l)
    min = tmp1 if min > tmp1
    min = tmp2 if min > tmp2
  end
  
  if n%5==0
    tmp = rec(n/5, memo, a, b, c, d)+c
    min = tmp if min > tmp
  else
    m = n%5
    l = 5-m
    tmp1 = rec((n-m)/5, memo, a, b, c, d)+c+(d*m)
    tmp2 = rec((n+l)/5, memo, a, b, c, d)+c+(d*l)
    min = tmp1 if min > tmp1
    min = tmp2 if min > tmp2
  end
  
  #p [n,min]
  memo[n] = min if !memo[n]
  return min
end

class Search
{
    private $_targetNum;
    private $_a;
    private $_b;
    private $_c;
    private $_d;
    private $_e;

    private $_minSpendCoin;
    private $_caseList;

    public function __construct($n, $a, $b, $c, $d)
    {
        $this->_targetNum = $n;
        $this->_a = $a;
        $this->_b = $b;
        $this->_c = $c;
        $this->_d = $d;
        $this->_e = $d;

        $this->_minSpendCoin = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $this->_caseList = [
            'A' => function ($v) {
                return $v * 2;
            },
            'B' => function ($v) {
                return $v * 3;
            },
            'C' => function ($v) {
                return $v * 5;
            },
            'D' => function ($v) {
                return $v + 1;
            },
            'E' => function ($v) {
                return $v - 1;
            },
        ];
    }

    protected function getSpendCoin($caseName)
    {
        switch ($caseName) {
            case 'A':
                return $this->_a;
            case 'B':
                return $this->_b;
            case 'C':
                return $this->_c;
            case 'D':
                return $this->_d;
            case 'E':
                return $this->_d;
        }
    }

    public function run()
    {
        // 最初に1枚にして、探索開始
        $this->_walk(1, $this->_d);
        echo $this->_minSpendCoin . PHP_EOL;
    }

    // 近づいた距離 / 支払ったコインの枚数 が最も小さいケースのコインを返却
    protected function _walk($nowNum, $spendCoin)
    {
        foreach ($this->_caseList as $caseName => $f) {
            $res = $f($nowNum);
            // 遠ざかったらcontinue
            if (abs($this->_targetNum - $res) > abs($this->_targetNum - $nowNum)) {
                continue;
            }

            // 発見した最小支払いを超えたらcontinue
            $resSpendCoin = $spendCoin + $this->getSpendCoin($caseName);
            if ($resSpendCoin > $this->_minSpendCoin) {
                continue;
            }

            // 最上の答えを見つけたら保存してcontinue
            if (abs($this->_targetNum - $res) == 0) {
                $this->_minSpendCoin = $resSpendCoin;
                return;
            }

            $this->_walk($res, $resSpendCoin);
        }
    }
}

function f($num)
{
    global $memo, $A, $B, $C, $D;

    if (isset($memo[$num])) return $memo[$num];

    $c = $num * $D;
    foreach ([[2, $A], [3, $B], [5, $C]] as $arr) {
        list($x, $X) = $arr;
        $next_num = intdiv($num, $x);
        $move = $num % $x;
        $c = min($c, $X + $move * $D + f($next_num));
        if ($move > 0) $c = min($c, $X + ($x - $move) * $D + f($next_num + 1));
    }

    $memo[$num] = $c;
    return $memo[$num];
}

class Search
{
    private $_targetNum;
    private $_a;
    private $_b;
    private $_c;
    private $_d;
    private $_e;

    private $_memo;

    public function __construct($n, $a, $b, $c, $d)
    {
        $this->_targetNum = $n;
        $this->_a = $a;
        $this->_b = $b;
        $this->_c = $c;
        $this->_d = $d;
        $this->_e = $d;

        $this->_memo = [];
    }

    public function run()
    {
        echo $this->walk($this->_targetNum) . PHP_EOL;
    }

    protected function walk($n)
    {
        $n = (int)$n;

        if ($n == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        if ($n == 1) {
            return $this->_d;
        }

        if (isset($this->_memo[$n])) {
            return $this->_memo[$n];
        }

        $result = min([
            $this->_d * (ceil($n / 5) * 5 - $n) + $this->_c + self::walk(ceil($n / 5)), // $nにxを足して5の倍数にして、5で割ったときのコスト
            $this->_d * ($n - floor($n / 5) * 5) + $this->_c + self::walk(floor($n / 5)), // $nにxを引いて5の倍数にして、5で割ったときのコスト
            $this->_d * (ceil($n / 3) * 3 - $n) + $this->_b + self::walk(ceil($n / 3)), // $nにxを足して3の倍数にして、3で割ったときのコスト
            $this->_d * ($n - floor($n / 3) * 3) + $this->_b + self::walk(floor($n / 3)), // $nにxを引いて3の倍数にして、3で割ったときのコスト
            $this->_d * (ceil($n / 2) * 2 - $n) + $this->_a + self::walk(ceil($n / 2)), // $nにxを足して2の倍数にして、2で割ったときのコスト
            $this->_d * ($n - floor($n / 2) * 2) + $this->_a + self::walk(floor($n / 2)), // $nにxを引いて2の倍数にして、2で割ったときのコスト
            $this->_d * $n
        ]);

//        $this->_memo[$n] = $result;

        return $result;
    }
}

function solve(){
  global $memo, $N;
  $memo = [];
  return cost($N);
}
function cost($i){
  global $N, $A, $B, $C, $D, $memo;
  if($i == 0)return 0;
  if($i == 1)return $D;
  if(isset($memo[$i]))return $memo[$i];
  $min = abs($i)*$D;

  $up2 = intdiv($i+1,2)*2;
  chmin($min, abs($up2-$i)*$D+$A+cost($up2/2));
  $down2 = intdiv($i,2)*2;
  chmin($min, abs($down2-$i)*$D+$A+cost($down2/2));

  $up3 = intdiv($i+2,3)*3;
  chmin($min, abs($up3-$i)*$D+$B+cost($up3/3));
  $down3 = intdiv($i,3)*3;
  chmin($min, abs($down3-$i)*$D+$B+cost($down3/3));

  $up5 = intdiv($i+4,5)*5;
  chmin($min, abs($up5-$i)*$D+$C+cost($up5/5));
  $down5 = intdiv($i,5)*5;
  chmin($min, abs($down5-$i)*$D+$C+cost($down5/5));

  $memo[$i] = $min;
  return $min;
}

function loadGraph($N = false, $M = false, $both = true){
  if($N === false)$N = $GLOBALS['N'];
  if($M === false)$M = $GLOBALS['M'];
  $G = array_fill(1, $N, []);
  for($i = 0; $i < $M; $i++){
    $values = ints();
    if(count($values) == 2){
      list($a, $b) = $values;
      if($both == 0){
        $G[$a][] = $b;
      }elseif($both == 1){
        $G[$a][] = $b;
        $G[$b][] = $a;
      }else{
        $G[$b][] = $a;
      }
    }else{
      list($a, $b, $d) = $values;
      if($both == 0){
        $G[$a][] = [$b, $d];
      }elseif($both == 1){
        $G[$a][] = [$b, $d];
        $G[$b][] = [$a, $d];
      }else{
        $G[$b][] = [$a, $d];
      }
    }
  }
  return $G;
}

function f($N)
{
    global $memo, $A, $B, $C, $D;
    if (isset($memo[$N])) return $memo[$N];
    $c = $N * $D;
    foreach ([[2, $A], [3, $B], [5, $C]] as list($x, $X)) {
        $q = intdiv($N, $x);
        $r = $N % $x;
        $c = min($c, $X + $r * $D + f($q));
        if ($r > 0) $c = min($c, $X + ($x - $r) * $D + f($q + 1));
    }
    $memo[$N] = $c;
    return $memo[$N];
}

type PriorityQueue[T] = object
  data:seq[T]
  comp:proc(x,y:T):int
proc initPriorityQueue[T]():PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:system.cmp[T])
proc initPriorityQueue[T](comp:proc(x,y:T):int):PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:comp)
proc `[]`[T](q: PriorityQueue[T], n: int): T = q.data[n]
proc `[]=`[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], n: int, item: T) = q.data[n] = item
proc len[T](q:PriorityQueue[T]): int = len(q.data)
proc shiftup[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx:int) =
  var i = idx
  while i != 0:
    let p = (i - 1) shr 1
    if q.comp(q[i], q[p]) >= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[i], q.data[p])
    i = p
proc shiftdown[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx: int) =
  var i = idx
  let n = len(q)
  while 2*i + 1 < n:
    var
      a = 2*i + 1
      b = 2*i + 2
    if b < n and q.comp(q[a], q[b]) > 0:
      a = b
    if q.comp(q[i], q[a]) <= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[a], q.data[i])
    i = a
proc push[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], item: T) =
  let n = len(q)
  q.data.add(item)
  shiftup(q, n)
proc pop[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  swap(q.data[0], q.data[^1])
  result = q.data.pop
  shiftdown(q, 0)

        stack.append((cur//2, cost + a + (cur % 2) * d))

class Paytowin:
    def __init__(self, a: int, b: int, c: int, d: int, n: int):
        self.a = a
        self.b = b
        self.c = c
        self.d = d
        self.n = n
        self.coin = n*d
        self.memo = {0: 0, 1: self.d}

    def solution(self, n: int):
        if n in self.memo:
            return self.memo[n]
        l2 = (n//2)*2
        r2 = ((n+1)//2)*2
        l3 = (n//3)*3
        r3 = ((n+2)//3)*3
        l5 = (n//5)*5
        r5 = ((n+4)//5)*5

        self.coin = min(self.coin, (n - l2) * self.d + self.a + self.solution(l2 // 2))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (r2 - n) * self.d + self.a + self.solution(r2 // 2))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (n - l3) * self.d + self.b + self.solution(l3 // 3))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (r3 - n) * self.d + self.b + self.solution(r3 // 3))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (n - l5) * self.d + self.c + self.solution(l5 // 5))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (r5 - n) * self.d + self.c + self.solution(r5 // 5))

        self.memo[n] = self.coin

        return self.coin

def F(x, A, B, C, D):
    if x == 1:

    elif x <= 0:

    if x&1:
        a = min(F(x//2, A, B, C, D) + D + A, F((x+1)//2, A, B, C, D) + D + A)
    else:
        a = F(x//2, A, B, C, D) + A
    cnt2 = 0
    y = x
    while y%3 != 0:
        y -= 1
        cnt2 += 1
    b = F(y//3, A, B, C, D) + B + cnt2 * D
    if (x+1)%3 == 0:
        t = F((x+1)//3, A, B, C, D) + B + D
        b = min(b, t)
    cnt3 = 0
    y = x
    while y%5 != 0:
        y -= 1
        cnt3 += 1
    c = min(F(y//5, A, B, C, D) + C + cnt3 * D, F((y+5)//5, A, B, C, D) + C + (5-cnt3) * D)
    ret = min(a, b, c)
    if x < 10 ** 12 or D < 10 ** 9:

class DFS:
    def __init__(self,n,a,b,c,d):
        self.N = n
        self.A = a
        self.B = b
        self.C = c
        self.D = d
        self.ans = self.N * self.D
        self.Q = deque([[n,0]])
    def dfs(self):
        while self.Q:
            num,cost = self.Q.popleft()
            if num == 0:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost)
            elif num == 1:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost + self.D * num)
            else:
                # 5の倍数に上げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//5 + 1) * 5 - num) * self.D + self.C
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に上げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//3 + 1) * 3 - num) * self.D + self.B
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                    
                # 2の倍数に上げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//2 + 1) * 2 - num) * self.D + self.A
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 全て引いた場合
                self.ans = min(self.ans, num*self.D + cost)
                
        return self.ans

def main():

    T = int(input())
    for _ in range(T):
        N, A, B, C, D = map(int, input().split())

        dq = deque()
        dq.append((0, N))  # cost,value
        checked = defaultdict(lambda: inf)

        ans = N * D + 1
        while dq:
            cost, x = dq.popleft()
            if cost >= ans: continue
            if cost > checked[x]: continue
            checked[x] = cost

            # 0まで1ずつ減らす
            ans = min(ans, cost + x * D)

            for d, c in ((2, A), (3, B), (5, C)):
                nx, r = divmod(x, d)
                if r <= d - r:
                    ncost = cost + r * D + c
                    if checked[nx] > ncost:
                        checked[nx] = ncost
                        dq.append((ncost, nx))
                else:
                    ncost = cost + (d - r) * D + c
                    if checked[nx + 1] > ncost:
                        checked[nx + 1] = ncost
                        dq.append((ncost, nx + 1))

        print(ans)

    t = [0] * 6
    while n > 0:
        if n % 2 == 0:
            n /= 2
            t[2] += 1
        elif n % 3 == 0:
            n /= 3
            t[3] += 1
        elif n % 5 == 0:
            n /= 5
            t[5] += 1
        else:
            n -= 1
            t[1] += 1

    return t

    p += a * count[2]

    p += c * count[5]
    p += d * count[1]
    #print(p)
    return p

            if num == 0:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost)
            elif num == 1:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost + self.D * num)
            else:
                # 5の倍数に上げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//5 + 1) * 5 - num) * self.D + self.C
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に上げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//3 + 1) * 3 - num) * self.D + self.B
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                    
                # 2の倍数に上げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//2 + 1) * 2 - num) * self.D + self.A
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 全て引いた場合
                self.ans = min(self.ans, num*self.D + cost)

def prime_factorize(n):
    a = []
    while n % 2 == 0:
        a.append(2)
        n //= 2
    f = 3
    while f * f <= n:
        if n % f == 0:
            a.append(f)
            n //= f
        else:
            f += 2
    if n != 1:
        a.append(n)
    return a

class DFS:
    def __init__(self,n,a,b,c,d):
        self.N = n
        self.A = a
        self.B = b
        self.C = c
        self.D = d
        self.ans = self.N * self.D
        self.Q = deque([[n,0]])
    def dfs(self):
        while self.Q:
            num,cost = self.Q.popleft()
            if num == 0:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost)
            elif num == 1:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost + self.D * num)
            else:
                # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 全て引いた場合
                self.ans = min(self.ans, num*self.D + cost)
                
        return self.ans

class Paytowin:
    def __init__(self, a: int, b: int, c: int, d: int, n: int):
        self.a = a
        self.b = b
        self.c = c
        self.d = d
        self.n = n
        self.coin = n*d
        self.memo = {0: 0, 1: self.d}

    def printnum(self):
        print(self.n)
        print(self.a)
        print(self.b)
        print(self.c)
        print(self.d)

    def solution(self, n: int):
        if n in self.memo:
            return self.memo[n]
        l2 = (n//2)*2
        r2 = ((n+1)//2)*2
        l3 = (n//3)*3
        r3 = ((n+2)//3)*3
        l5 = (n//5)*5
        r5 = ((n+4)//5)*5

        self.coin = min(self.coin, (n - l2) * self.d + self.a + self.solution(l2 // 2))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (r2 - n) * self.d + self.a + self.solution(r2 // 2))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (n - l3) * self.d + self.b + self.solution(l3 // 3))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (r3 - n) * self.d + self.b + self.solution(r3 // 3))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (n - l5) * self.d + self.c + self.solution(l5 // 5))
        self.coin = min(self.coin, (r5 - n) * self.d + self.c + self.solution(r5 // 5))

        self.memo[n] = self.coin

        return self.coin

    heap = []

        if n == 0:

        for cost, div in cands:

            elif n % div == 0:
                next_n = n // div
                next_c = cost
                ncs.append((next_n, next_c))
            else:
                r = n % div
                next_n = (n-r) // div
                next_c = cost + r*D
                ncs.append((next_n, next_c))
                next_n = (n+r) // div
                next_c = cost + (div-r)*D
                ncs.append((next_n, next_c))
            for next_n, next_c in ncs:
                next_c += c
                if next_n in visited:
                    if visited[next_n] <= next_c:

                heapq.heappush(heap, (next_c, next_n))

    a = []

    return a

from heapq import heapify, heappush as hpush, heappop as hpop

def dijkstra(n, E, i0=0):
    h = [[0, i0]]
    D = [-1] * n
    done = [0] * n
    D[i0] = 0
    
    while h:
        d, i = hpop(h)
        done[i] = 1
        for j, w in E[i]:
            nd = d + w
            if D[j] < 0 or D[j] > nd:
                if done[j] == 0:
                    hpush(h, [nd, j])
                    D[j] = nd
    return D

    dist[N] = D * N
    heapq.heappush(heap, (0, 0))
    while heap:
        cnt, n = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if dist[N] <= cnt:
            break
        if dist[n] < cnt:
            continue
        if n == N:
            break
        if n > N:
            dist[n] = cnt + abs(N - n)
        if cnt + A < dist[n * 2]:
            dist[n * 2] = cnt + A
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + A, n * 2))
        if cnt + B < dist[n * 3]:
            dist[n * 3] = cnt + B
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + B, n * 3))
        if cnt + C < dist[n * 5]:
            dist[n * 5] = cnt + C
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + C, n * 5))
        if cnt + D < dist[n + 1]:
            dist[n + 1] = cnt + D
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + D, n + 1))
        if cnt + D < dist[n - 1] and n - 1 > 0:
            dist[n - 1] = cnt + D
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + D, n - 1))
    return dist[N]


def solve(N, A, B, C, D):
    dist = defaultdict(lambda: INF)
    dist[N] = 0
    # dist[0] = N * D
    heap = [(0, N)]
    while heap:
        cnt, n = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if dist[n] < cnt:
            continue
        if n <= 5:
            dist[0] = min(dist[0], cnt + n * D)

        if cnt + abs(n - n // 2) * D < dist[n // 2]:
            dist[n // 2] = cnt + abs(n - n // 2) * D
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + abs(n - n // 2) * D, n // 2))
        if cnt + abs(n - n // 3) * D < dist[n // 3]:
            dist[n // 3] = cnt + abs(n - n // 3) * D
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + abs(n - n // 3) * D, n // 3))
        if cnt + abs(n - n // 5) * D < dist[n // 5]:
            dist[n // 5] = cnt + abs(n - n // 5) * D
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + abs(n - n // 5) * D, n // 5))

        l = n // 2 * 2
        d = A + abs(l - n) * D
        if A < abs(n - l // 2) * D and cnt + d < dist[l // 2]:
            dist[l // 2] = cnt + d
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + d, l // 2))
        r = l + 2
        d = A + abs(r - n) * D
        if A < abs(n - r // 2) * D and cnt + d < dist[r // 2]:
            dist[r // 2] = cnt + d
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + d, r // 2))

        l = n // 3 * 3
        d = B + abs(l - n) * D
        if B < abs(n - l // 3) * D and cnt + d < dist[l // 3]:
            dist[l // 3] = cnt + d
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + d, l // 3))
        r = l + 3
        d = B + abs(r - n) * D
        if B < abs(n - r // 3) * D and cnt + d < dist[r // 3]:
            dist[r // 3] = cnt + d
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + d, r // 3))

        l = n // 5 * 5
        d = C + abs(l - n) * D
        if C < abs(n - l // 5) * D and cnt + d < dist[l // 5]:
            dist[l // 5] = cnt + d
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + d, l // 5))
        r = l + 5
        d = C + abs(r - n) * D
        if C < abs(n - r // 5) * D and cnt + d < dist[r // 5]:
            dist[r // 5] = cnt + d
            heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt + d, r // 5))

    return dist[0]

class DFS:
    def __init__(self,n,a,b,c,d):
        self.N = n
        self.A = a
        self.B = b
        self.C = c
        self.D = d
        self.ans = self.N * self.D
        self.Q = deque([[n,0]])
        self.memory = defaultdict(int) # 実績を記録、すでにその値より低いコストでやっていたら除外する
    def dfs(self):
        while self.Q:
            # from IPython.core.debugger import Pdb; Pdb().set_trace()
            num,cost = self.Q.popleft()
            # 小さいコストのキューが積まれていた場合は処理しない（後ろのキューで処理をする）
            if memory[num] <= cost:
                pass
            else:
                if num == 0:
                    self.ans = min(self.ans, cost)
                elif num == 1:
                    self.ans = min(self.ans, cost + self.D * num)
                else:
                    # 5の倍数に上げて5で割った場合
                    temp_num = num//5 + 1
                    temp_cost = cost + ((num//5 + 1) * 5 - num) * self.D + self.C
                    if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                        self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                        self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])

                    # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                    temp_num = num//5
                    temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                    if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                        self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                        self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])

                    # 3の倍数に上げて3で割った場合
                    temp_num = num//3 + 1
                    temp_cost = cost + ((num//3 + 1) * 3 - num) * self.D + self.B
                    if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                        self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                        self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])

                    # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                    temp_num = num//3
                    temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                    if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                        self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                        self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])

                    # 2の倍数に上げて2で割った場合
                    temp_num = num//2 + 1
                    temp_cost = cost + ((num//2 + 1) * 2 - num) * self.D + self.A
                    if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                        self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                        self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])

                    # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                    temp_num = num//2
                    temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                    if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                        self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                        self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])

                    # 全て引いた場合
                    self.ans = min(self.ans, num*self.D + cost)
                
        return self.ans

def estimateZeroToFive(A, B, C, D):
    List = [0] * 7
    List[1] = D
    List[2] = min(A+D, 2 * D)
    List[3] = min(3*D, List[2] + D, List[1] + B)
    List[6] = min(6*D, List[2] + B, List[3] + A, C+2*D)
    List[4] = min(4*D, List[2] + A, List[3] + D, 2*D+C, List[2]+B+2*D)
    List[5] = min(5*D, List[1] + C, List[4] + D, List[6] + D, List[2]+B+D )

    return List

    else:

def bfs(cur, cost, a, b, c, d, target):
    memo = {0: float('inf')}
    stack = deque([(cur, cost)])
    while stack:
        cur, cost = stack.popleft()
        if cur in memo and memo[cur] <= cost:
            continue
        if cur > 2 * target:
            continue
        if cur < 0:
            continue
        memo[cur] = cost
        memo[0] = min(memo[0], cost + cur * d)
        stack.append((cur//5, cost + c + (cur % 5) * d))
        stack.append((cur//5 + 1, cost + c + (5 - cur % 5) * d))
        stack.append((cur//3, cost + b + (cur % 3) * d))
        stack.append((cur//3 + 1, cost + b + (3 - cur % 3) * d))
        stack.append((cur//2, cost + a + (cur % 2) * d))
        stack.append((cur//2 + 1, cost + a + (2 - cur % 2) * d))

    return memo[0]

    if N == 0:
        return 0
    
    if N == 1:
        return E[-1]

    if N in memo:
        return memo[N]

    res = N * E[-1]
    for k in (2, 3, 5):

        res = min(res, (r - N) * E[-1] + E[k] + f(r // k, E, memo))
    memo[N] = res
    return res

def estimateZeroToFive(A, B, C, D):
    List = [0] * 7
    List[1] = D
    List[2] = min(A+D, 2 * D)
    List[3] = min(3*D, List[2] + D, List[1] + B)
    List[6] = min(6*D, List[2] + B, List[3] + A, C+2*D)
    List[4] = min(4*D, List[2] + A, List[3] + D, 2*D+C, List[2]+B+2*D)
    List[5] = min(5*D, List[1] + C, List[4] + D, List[6] + D, List[2]+B+D )

    return List

def queue(Queue_CostValue):
    Values = Queue_CostValue.pop(0)
    return Values

def OneTurn(A, B, C, D, Costs_ZeroToFive, Acchieved, Queue_CostValue_Turns):
    while(len(Queue_CostValue_Turns)>0):

        CostValue = queue(Queue_CostValue_Turns)

        Cost = CostValue[0]
        Value = CostValue[1]
        CostMin = Acchieved[0]
        Flag = True
        if(Cost > CostMin):
            Flag = False
        elif(Value <= 6):
            Cost += Costs_ZeroToFive[Value]
            if(Cost < CostMin):
                Acchieved[0] = Cost
                Flag = False
        if(Flag==True):
            if(Value %5 ==0):
                Queue_CostValue_Turns.append([Cost+C, Value//5 ])
            if(Value%3 == 0):
                Queue_CostValue_Turns.append([Cost+B, Value//3 ])
            if(Value%2==0):
                Queue_CostValue_Turns.append([Cost+A, Value//2 ])

            Queue_CostValue_Turns.append([Cost+D, Value+1])
            Queue_CostValue_Turns.append([Cost+D, Value-1])
            OneTurn(A, B, C, D, Costs_ZeroToFive, Acchieved, Queue_CostValue_Turns)

from collections import deque,defaultdict
class DFS:
    def __init__(self,n,a,b,c,d):
        self.N = n
        self.A = a
        self.B = b
        self.C = c
        self.D = d
        self.ans = self.N * self.D
        self.Q = deque([[n,0]])
        self.memory = defaultdict(int) # 実績を記録、すでにその値より低いコストでやっていたら除外する
    def dfs(self):
        while self.Q:
#             from IPython.core.debugger import Pdb; Pdb().set_trace()
            num,cost = self.Q.popleft()
            if num == 0:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost)
            elif num == 1:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost + self.D * num)
            else:
                # 5の倍数に上げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//5 + 1) * 5 - num) * self.D + self.C
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に上げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//3 + 1) * 3 - num) * self.D + self.B
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                    
                # 2の倍数に上げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//2 + 1) * 2 - num) * self.D + self.A
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 全て引いた場合
                self.ans = min(self.ans, num*self.D + cost)
                
        return self.ans

MEMO = {}

def solve(N, A, B, C, D):
    # 戦略
    # 0からNを作るのではなく、
    # Nから+-1, /2, /3, /5 の操作を繰り返して
    # 0にたどり着くことを考える

    if N == 0:
        return 0
    elif N == 1:
        return D
    elif N in MEMO:
        return MEMO[N]
    
    # 例: N = 13 の場合
    # 0から13にたどり着くまでに、次の7通りが考えられる
    # 1. 0から+1を13回繰り返す: コスト = D * 13
    # 2. 6を2倍して+1: コスト = [0から6を作るコスト] + A + D * (13 - 12)
    # 3. 7を2倍して-1: コスト = [0から7を作るコスト] + A + D * (14 - 13)
    # 4. 4を3倍して+1: コスト = [0から4を作るコスト] + B + D * (13 - 12)
    # 5. 5を3倍して-2: コスト = [0から5を作るコスト] + B + D * (15 - 13)
    # 6. 2を5倍して+3: コスト = [0から2を作るコスト] + C + D * (13 - 10)
    # 7. 3を5倍して-2: コスト = [0から3を作るコスト] + C + D * (15 - 13)

    min_score = D * N # case 1

    # # case 2, 3
    # div2_1 = N // 2
    # div2_2 = (N + 1) // 2
    # min_score = min(min_score, solve(div2_1, A, B, C, D) + A + D * abs(N - 2 * div2_1))
    # min_score = min(min_score, solve(div2_2, A, B, C, D) + A + D * abs(N - 2 * div2_2))

    # # case 4, 5
    # div3_1 = N // 3
    # div3_2 = (N + 2) // 3
    # min_score = min(min_score, solve(div3_1, A, B, C, D) + B + D * abs(N - 3 * div3_1))
    # min_score = min(min_score, solve(div3_2, A, B, C, D) + B + D * abs(N - 3 * div3_2))

    # # case 6, 7
    # div5_1 = N // 5
    # div5_2 = (N + 4) // 5
    # min_score = min(min_score, solve(div5_1, A, B, C, D) + C + D * abs(N - 5 * div5_1))
    # min_score = min(min_score, solve(div5_2, A, B, C, D) + C + D * abs(N - 5 * div5_2))

    # 丁寧に書くと上のようになるが、
    # 面倒なので下のようにしてまとめる
    div_score = {2: A, 3: B, 5: C}

    for d, s in div_score.items():
        div1 = N // d
        div2 = (N + d - 1) // d
        min_score = min(min_score, solve(div1, A, B, C, D) + s + D * abs(N - d * div1))
        min_score = min(min_score, solve(div2, A, B, C, D) + s + D * abs(N - d * div2))

    # 再帰呼び出しで同じNについて何回も計算する可能性があるので、
    # 1度計算した値はメモしておく
    MEMO[N] = min_score
    return min_score

def prime_factorize(n):
    a = []
    while n % 2 == 0:
        a.append(2)
        n //= 2
    f = 3
    while f * f <= n:
        if n % f == 0:
            a.append(f)
            n //= f
        else:
            f += 2
    if n != 1:
        a.append(n)
    return a

def ggg(n,a,b,c,d):
	init = n
	open = queue.PriorityQueue()
	close = set()
	open.put((0, n))
	min_v = n*d
	while not open.empty():
		cost, pos = open.get()
		if pos in close:
			continue
		if cost > min_v:
			continue
		
		min_v = min(min_v, cost+pos*d)
		for c, add in zip([a,b,c],[2,3,5]):
			k = pos % add
			nc = cost + k*d + c
			np = pos // add
			if nc <= min_v and np not in close:
				open.put((nc, np))
				#pa((nc,np))
			nnc = cost + (add-k) *d + c
			nnp = (pos + add) // add
			if nnc <= min_v and nnp not in close:
				open.put((nnc, nnp))
				#pa((nnc,nnp))
		close.add(pos)
	return min_v

def solve(N, A, B, C, D):
    "void()"

    MIN_COST = min(A, B, C, D)

    to_visit = [-N]
    cost = {N: 0}

    answer = 1e+99

    def put(n, c):
        # dp("put: n,c", n, c)
        cost[n] = min(cost.get(n, INF), c)
        heappush(to_visit, -n)

    visited = N + 1
    while to_visit:
        n = -heappop(to_visit)
        if n == visited:
            continue
        # dp("visit: n", n, cost)

        visited = n
        c = cost[n]
        put(0, c + n * D)

        if n % 2 == 0:
            put(n // 2, c + A)
        else:
            put((n+1) // 2, c + A + D)
            put((n-1) // 2, c + A + D)

        if n % 3 == 0:
            put(n // 3, c + B)
        elif n % 3 == 1:
            put((n-1) // 3, c + B + D)
            put((n+2) // 3, c + B + D * 2)
        else:
            put((n+1) // 3, c + B + D)
            put((n-2) // 3, c + B + D * 2)

        if n % 5 == 0:
            put(n // 5, c + C)
        elif n % 5 == 1:
            put((n-1) // 5, c + C + D)
            put((n+4) // 5, c + C + D * 4)
        elif n % 5 == 2:
            put((n-2) // 5, c + C + D * 2)
            put((n+3) // 5, c + C + D * 3)
        elif n % 5 == 3:
            put((n+2) // 5, c + C + D * 2)
            put((n-3) // 5, c + C + D * 3)
        elif n % 5 == 4:
            put((n+1) // 5, c + C + D)
            put((n-4) // 5, c + C + D * 4)

    return cost[0]

        self.A = a

def solve(N, d, cache):
    if N in cache:
        return cache[N]

    if N == 0:
        return 0
    if N == 1:
        return d.D

    ans = d.D * N

    for (n, coeff) in ((2, d.A), (3, d.B), (5, d.C)):
        if N % n == 0:
            ans1 = coeff + solve(N // n, d, cache)
            ans = min(ans, ans1)
        else:
            left = N % n
            ans2 = d.D * left + coeff + solve((N - left) // n, d, cache)

            right = n - left
            ans3 = d.D * right + coeff + solve((N + right) // n, d, cache)

            ans = min(ans, ans2, ans3)

    cache[N] = ans
    return ans

        N, A, B, C, D = map(int, input().split())

def solve(n, a, b, c, d, bi=1):

    curr = n
    coin = d

    while curr != 1:
        ca = curr / 2 / a
        cb = curr * 2 / 3 / b
        cc = curr * 4 / 5 / c
        cd = 1 / d

        cs = [(ca, 2, a), (cb, 3, b), (cc, 5, c), (cd, 1, d)]
        cs.sort(reverse=True)

        if cs[0][1] == 1:
            curr = 1
            coin += (curr - 1) * d
            break

        if curr % 2 != 0 and curr % 3 != 0 and curr % 5 != 0:
            curr += bi
            coin += d
            continue

        if curr % cs[0][1] == 0 and cs[0][1] != 1 and curr >= cs[0][1]:
            curr //= cs[0][1]
            coin += cs[0][2]
            continue

        if curr % cs[1][1] == 0 and cs[1][1] != 1 and curr >= cs[1][1]:
            curr //= cs[1][1]
            coin += cs[1][2]
            continue

        if curr % cs[2][1] == 0 and cs[2][1] != 1 and curr >= cs[2][1]:
            curr //= cs[2][1]
            coin += cs[2][2]
            continue

        if curr % cs[3][1] == 0 and cs[3][1] != 1 and curr >= cs[3][1]:
            curr //= cs[3][1]
            coin += cs[3][2]
            continue

        coin = float("inf")
        break

    return coin

  dic[num] = ans
  MAX = min(coin+ans, MAX)
  return ans

def P_change(N, P):
    #Salsa
    for i in range(N):
        start = 3 ** i
        stop = 3 ** N
        step = 3 ** (i + 1)
        dp = 3 ** i
        for j in range(start, stop, step):
            P[j:j + dp], P[j + dp:j + dp * 2] = P[j + dp:j + dp * 2], P[j:j + dp]

    return P


def P_slide(P):

    temp = P[-1]
    P[1:] = P[:-1]
    P[0] = temp

            P = P_slide(P)

    N3 = 3 ** N
    R = [0] * N3
    for i in range(N3):
        R[P[i]] = i

def bfs(cur, cost, a, b, c, d, target):
    memo = {0: float('inf')}
    stack = deque([(cur, cost)])
    while stack:
        cur, cost = stack.pop()
        if cur in memo and memo[cur] <= cost:
            continue
        if cur > 2 * target:
            continue
        if cur < 0:
            continue
        memo[cur] = cost
        memo[0] = min(memo[0], cost + cur * d)
        stack.append((cur//5, cost + c + (cur % 5) * d))
        stack.append((cur//5 + 1, cost + c + (5 - cur % 5) * d))
        stack.append((cur//3, cost + b + (cur % 3) * d))
        stack.append((cur//3 + 1, cost + b + (3 - cur % 3) * d))
        stack.append((cur//2, cost + a + (cur % 2) * d))
        stack.append((cur//2 + 1, cost + a + (2 - cur % 2) * d))

    return memo[0]

def prime_factorize(n):
    a = []
    while n % 2 == 0:
        a.append(2)
        n //= 2
    f = 3
    while f * f <= n:
        if n % f == 0:
            a.append(f)
            n //= f
        else:
            f += 2
    if n != 1:
        a.append(n)
    return a

class DFS:
    def __init__(self,n,a,b,c,d):
        self.N = n
        self.A = a
        self.B = b
        self.C = c
        self.D = d
        self.ans = self.N * self.D
        self.Q = [[0,n]]
    def dfs(self):
        while self.Q:
#             from IPython.core.debugger import Pdb; Pdb().set_trace()
            cost,num = heapq.heappop(self.Q)
            if num == 0:
                return cost
            elif num == 1:
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[cost+self.D,0])
            else:
                # 5の倍数に上げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//5 + 1) * 5 - num) * self.D + self.C
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])

                # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])

                # 3の倍数に上げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//3 + 1) * 3 - num) * self.D + self.B
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])

                # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])

                # 2の倍数に上げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2 + 1
                temp_cost = cost + ((num//2 + 1) * 2 - num) * self.D + self.A
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])

                # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])

                # 全て引いた場合
                heapq.heappush(self.Q,[temp_cost,temp_num])
                
        return self.ans

        N, A, B, C, D = map(int, input().split())

        dq = deque()
        dq.append((0, N))  # cost,value
        checked = defaultdict(lambda: inf)
        checked[N] = 0

        ans = N * D + 1
        while dq:
            cost, x = dq.popleft()
            if cost >= ans: continue
            if cost > checked[x]: continue

            # 0まで1ずつ減らす
            ans = min(ans, cost + x * D)

            for d, c in ((2, A), (3, B), (5, C)):
                nx, r = divmod(x, d)
                if r <= d - r:
                    ncost = cost + r * D + c
                    if checked[nx] > ncost:
                        checked[nx] = ncost
                        dq.append((ncost, nx))
                else:
                    ncost = cost + (d - r) * D + c
                    if checked[nx + 1] > ncost:
                        checked[nx + 1] = ncost
                        dq.append((ncost, nx + 1))

        print(ans)

def a(N,A,B,C,D):

    arr = [(2,A),(3,B),(5,C)]
    # Nから0までのコストを計算する
    # ヒープは最小の要素が先頭に来る
    # D[0]を超えたら打ち切る
    aa = 0
    bb = 0
    num = 0
    H = [N]
    E[N] = 0
    while len(H) != 0:
        num = heapq.heappop(H)
        if E[num] >= E[0]:
            continue
        E[0] = min(E[0],E[num] + D * num)
        for k,v in arr:
            aa = num // k
            bb = E[num] + D * (num - aa * k) + v
            if E[aa] > bb:
                E[aa] = bb
                heapq.heappush(H,aa)
            aa += 1
            bb = E[num] + D * (aa * k - num) + v
            if E[aa] > bb:
                E[aa] = bb
                heapq.heappush(H,aa)
    print(E[0])

        while h:
            cost, x = heappop(h)
            if cost >= ans: continue
            if x in checked: continue
            checked.add(x)

            # 0まで1ずつ減らす
            if ans > cost + x * D:
                ans = cost + x * D

                if nx not in checked:
                    heappush(h, (cost + r * D + c, nx))
                if (nx + 1) not in checked:
                    heappush(h, (cost + (d - r) * D + c, nx + 1))

        print(ans)

def factorization(n):
    arr = []

            arr.append([i, cnt])

from collections import deque,defaultdict
class DFS:
    def __init__(self,n,a,b,c,d):
        self.N = n
        self.A = a
        self.B = b
        self.C = c
        self.D = d
        self.ans = self.N * self.D
        self.Q = deque([[n,0]])
        self.memory = defaultdict(int) # 実績を記録、すでにその値より低いコストでやっていたら除外する
    def dfs(self):
        while self.Q:
#             from IPython.core.debugger import Pdb; Pdb().set_trace()
            num,cost = self.Q.popleft()
            if num == 0:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost)
            elif num == 1:
                self.ans = min(self.ans, cost + self.D * num)
            else:
                # 5の倍数に下げて5で割った場合
                temp_num = num//5
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//5)*5) * self.D + self.C
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 3の倍数に下げて3で割った場合
                temp_num = num//3
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//3)*3) * self.D + self.B
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 2の倍数に下げて2で割った場合
                temp_num = num//2
                temp_cost = cost + (num - (num//2)*2) * self.D + self.A
                if self.memory[temp_num] == 0 or self.memory[temp_num] > cost:
                    self.memory[temp_num] = temp_cost
                    self.Q.appendleft([temp_num,temp_cost])
                
                # 全て引いた場合
                self.ans = min(self.ans, num*self.D + cost)
                
        return self.ans
